# Prompt Optimizer (提示词优化)

A DSH plugin that rewrites what you type into the composer into a precise
prompt **before** the mode

l sees it, using one cheap side call on the session's
own route.

The rewritten text is what enters the durable log, so the chat bubble and the
model always agree: yo
u never see one thing and send another.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Or install the prebuilt tarball from the
latest release
through the app's plugin manager. No build s
tep, no `allowBuilds` approval.

Also listed in the plugin catalog:
awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/devzer0o0/dsh-prompt-optimizer.
## Turning it on

The switch is the whale in the composer's tool row
(`conversation.input.right`), between the model s

whale in the composer's tool row
(`conversation.input.right`), between the model selector and Send.

Click it to toggle; the state lives in `~/.dsh/prompt-optimizer/state.json` and
survives a restart.

Hover it to read the last before/after pair for the current
conversation.
### Two states
| state | rendering |
| **off** (default) | a dark silhouette used as a CSS mask over `currentColor`, so it carries **no f

ill colour of its own** and follows the host theme |
| **on** | the full-colour gold artwork |

Both states are inlined into `client.js` as data URIs. The chip is a 16px
control that must paint on

the first frame, and a round trip per state would
flash an empty button. `assets/` keeps the source

PNGs the constants are
generated from.
## What it does

While it is on, every message you send that looks like prose gets one
non-streaming call that turns

it into a structured prompt: goal first, then the
constraints and acceptance criteria already implie

d by what you typed. Concrete
details — paths, names, numbers, error text — are preserved, chit-chat

is
dropped, and the original language is kept.
## What it never touches

- Slash commands (`/compact`, …), messages shorter than `minChars`, messages
longer than `maxInputCh

ars`, and image-only messages.
- A message it already rewrote inside the same turn (identified by me

ssage id).
- Anything when the side call fails: a provider error, a timeout, or an empty
rewrite sen

ds the text exactly as you typed it, and the failure is logged as a
warning (`dsh-prompt-optimizer:
rewrite failed; …`).
## Where it hooks

`agent/pre-step` — the one waterfall that decides which messages enter a step.
`agent/request` is de

liberately not used (the loop refuses message changes
there), and a request-side hook would rewrite

a message already in the durable
log, so the transcript would disagree with the model.

The listener spreads the incoming decision (`{ ...decision, messages }`), so
fields such as `startsR

equestSeries` and notices added by later listeners
survive.
## Configuration
`cordis.patch.yml` in this bundle is the only config surface:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The switch in the composer writes the state file, which wins over this row;
`enabled` here is just t

he initial posture. The rest of the knobs live in the
state file and can be edited by hand:
| field | default | meaning |

| `enabled` | `false` | the switch |
| `provider` / `model` | `""` | pin the rewrite route; empty =

the session's own route |
| `minChars` | `8` | shorter messages are sent untouched |
| `maxInputChar

s` | `6000` | longer messages are sent untouched |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `1200` | cap for the rewrit

e call |
| `timeoutMs` | `12000` | deadline for the rewrite call |
| `history` | `20` | how many rew
rites the hover panel can read back |
## HTTP surface
`GET /prompt-optimizer/state[?sessionId=…]` → `{ ok, enabled, minChars, route, last }`
`POST /prompt-optimizer/state` with `{ "enabled": true }` → `{ ok, enabled }`

Both are served by the client half's toggle. There is no remote RPC: the route
is tiny and does not

served by the client half's toggle. There is no remote RPC: the route
is tiny and does not need one.
## Display

- Title / description: `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` (`meta.title`,
`meta.description`).
- Icon

: `icon.png` (256×256, the gold whale on a dark tile), exported as
`./icon`.
